description: A stereo peak meter: two columns of 14 lamps showing the level of the left and the right input.

inputs.text: The left channel to meter; full scale on the column is 5V.
The right channel to meter; full scale on the column is 5V.

notes: The lamps rise the instant the level does and fall back over about 300 milliseconds. Nothing passes through the module: there are no outputs, so patch the signal here with a split or a mult.
